stories.title: Three ways to harvest Phu Quoc pepper
stories.dek: Black pepper, stuffed pepper and pickled pepper are different from the moment the grower decides which seeds to pick on the string. Looking at the meticulous harvesting method, you can understand why each picked pepper is expensive and labor-intensive.
stories.intro: On a Phu Quoc pepper jar, there is always the presence of green fruits, yellow budding fruits and ripe red berries. Depending on the intention, the gardener can pick the whole pepper to make black pepper, keep the green and red fruits mixed to form stuffed pepper, or patiently pick each ripe fruit separately to produce a high-class batch of pepper. That sophistication begins with the rustic hands of the picker, long before the pepper rises on the dipping cup.
stories.image_alt: Pepper garden on Phu Quoc island
stories.image_caption: Pepper garden in Phu Quoc.

sections.heading: The three names lie in the way of picking
sections.body: After drying, black pepper is wrinkled with a characteristic dark skin. Stuffed pepper is a mixture of green and red fruits, uneven ripeness, creating diverse layers of flavor after drying. Meanwhile, picking pepper is the ultimate patience: the picker carefully selects each ripe red fruit on the tree and then collects it to dry separately. The difference does not lie in the recipe, but in the harvest rhythm in the middle of the sunny pepper garden.

sections.heading: Picking is in the taste
sections.body: Pepper growers on Pearl Island only need to smell the aroma or taste the spicy taste to know which batch of pepper is picked separately when ripe. The work of picking each seed not only makes the harvest time many times longer; the craftsman still preserves that habit because they know the value it brings to cuisine. Just lightly pound a few picked peppercorns into a cup of fish or seafood sauce, the strong aroma will rise first, and then the deep spicy taste will spread at the end.

sections.heading: Science partially explains
sections.body:
From a scientific perspective, the active ingredient piperine determines the pungent taste, while the volatile essential oil compounds create the characteristic aroma of pepper. Some studies have analyzed the composition of essential oils in Phu Quoc white pepper, but have never put the three types of black pepper, stuffed pepper and pickled pepper on the scale of in-depth comparison. 

In addition, the experience of fertilizing the soil with composted fish carcasses is the lifelong secret of many island garden owners. Although Can Tho University has conducted studies on the soil characteristics and yield of Phu Quoc pepper by fertilizing methods, there has not been any work that has separately measured the effect of fish carcasses on the pepper aftertaste. Therefore, the story of the "sea aftertaste" mixed in Phu Quoc pepper is still a poetic touch, waiting for further discoveries.

stories.title: One year in barrel house
stories.dek: The journey from fresh anchovies and sea salt grains to a cup of fish sauce is a long year of meticulously watching each barrel. It's a series of dedicated craftsmanship, not just for time.
stories.intro: Stepping into the barrel house, the first impression is the giant wooden barrels standing silently with the strong smell of composting in the space. The long-time worker revealed that the traditional golden ratio is 2.5 to 3 parts of fresh anchovies mixed with 1 part of granulated salt. The freshly caught fish is thoroughly filtered, washed with pure seawater and then salted. From that moment, a batch of rich fish sauce begins a long and elaborate journey, where every breath of the chup needs meticulous hand care.
stories.image_alt: Fish brewing barrels for fish sauce in Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Fish incubation barrels in a fish sauce facility in Phu Quoc.

sections.heading: Batch Opening Rate
sections.body: Salt plays a role in keeping the fish meat from decomposed, creating the perfect environment for natural fermentation. However, mixing fish with salt is just the beginning. About the first 3 to 4 days, the water in the barrel is drained; the worker flattens the surface of the barrel and then covers it with a layer of granulated salt 2 to 3 cmthick. After 3 to 4 days, the barrel is compacted with large wooden sticks before the water is recirculated again. Each milestone requires precision, there is absolutely no need to finish the compression and then leave the barrel unattended over the years.

sections.heading: Barrel Tracker
sections.body: Depending on the family's secrets, some barrel houses choose the stirring method, some are loyal to the compression, or a combination of both. During many months of brewing, the worker must constantly monitor the color of the water, aroma and detect any signs of sour or misalignment. Enough time is just a necessary condition; the "feeling" of the transformation inside the barrel requires experience accumulated through many seasons, through thousands of tastings and adjustments to the hand.

sections.heading: From the barrel to the cup of dipping sauce
sections.body:
In wooden barrels, natural enzymes from fish organs break down proteins into soluble amino acid chains, creating a rich umami taste after sweetness. A 2021 study of anchovy fish sauce showed that flavor compounds increased markedly over time: a 12-month sample had a measured umami index that was 17% higher than a 6-month sample. 

When the batch reaches perfect ripeness, the fish sauce is peeled, compressed and circulated through wooden barrels until it reaches a transparent and matching cockroach wing color. All the patience and dedication for a year finally settles in the cup of dipping sauce on the family rice tray.

stories.title: Duong Dong after 5 p.m.
stories.dek: When the sunset falls on Duong Dong, the island town is dressed in a brilliant two-sided rhythm of life: tourists leisurely looking for a place to eat dinner, locals are off their shifts, shops are lit up with lights, and boats are still rhythmically entering and exiting the river mouth.
stories.intro: The sunset in Duong Dong is not a signal of rest for all, but a point of intersection between the rhythms of life. The flow of people blends into the flow of tourists; the streets begin to gather kitchens and lights, and at the mouth of the river, boats are still busy turning the waves for the night sea. If you want to feel the soul of the island town, you just need to slow down a few steps, spend more time feeling the rhythm of life.
stories.image_alt: Entrance to Phu Quoc night market in the evening, photo in December 2025
stories.image_caption: The entrance to Phu Quoc night market, taken on 28/12/2025.

sections.heading: The street is over, the street is lit up
sections.body: As the rhythm of the market gradually subsides in the center, countless eateries along the streets are busy welcoming customers. Just a few steps away to the mouth of the river, the sound of boats and the hustle and bustle of many people continue endlessly. These two worlds exist in parallel, but if you just rush to take a car from the hotel to the night market, you will accidentally miss the gentle silence of the island town. Try walking around the small alleys, Duong Dong will open up more authentic and warm than any travel guide.

sections.heading: The night market is just part of the dinner
sections.body: The night market is brilliant with fresh seafood stalls and souvenirs, but the family eateries tucked away in small alleys offer rustic but flavorful local rice trays. When ordering seafood by the scale, feel free to ask for the price and processing costs before finalizing the dish. If you don't like the crowded atmosphere, just turn into a small road and you can enjoy a very peaceful corner of the space.

sections.heading: An evening without running in many places
sections.body: During the evening rush hour, the main roads in Duong Dong are quite crowded and it is difficult to find a parking space. Instead of rushing through too many check-in points, choose a satisfactory corner of the restaurant and spend time walking around the riverbank. Standing in the public walkway watching the boats pass by under the shimmering street lights, dinner in the island town is sometimes simple but leaves a strangely deep aftertaste.

stories.title: Painted eyes on the nose of the boat
stories.dek: In the past, on the nose of the boats moored in Phu Quoc, there was always a pair of brightly painted eyes. It is not only an artistic touch, but a deep spiritual belief of fishermen in the midst of the hustle and bustle of life at the fishing wharf.
stories.intro: In the midst of the busy scenery of the harbor in the past - where boats are parked, people loading fish, and people moving cold ice prepare for a long voyage - the eyes painted on the bow of the boat are like a calm gaze that attracts the eyes of passers-by. Behind that painting is the belief that conveys the wish of peace of seafarers, blending with the rustic rhythm of enthusiastic labor at the mouth of the river.
stories.image_alt: Fishing vessels near Phu Quoc port in 2025
stories.image_caption: Fishing boat near Phu Quoc port, taken on 12/11/2025. Photo of the marine industry, does not confirm the details seen in the photo.

sections.heading: Eye of the boat by the fishing wharf
sections.body:
Each pair of boat eyes has a very unique stroke and charisma: there is a majestic thick brush stroke, and there is a gentle bright color. For each shipbuilder or boat owner, those eyes are a distinct mark, a decoration and a tradition of praying for peace for generations. 

Right below the eyes of the boat facing the distant sea, the rhythm of life at the fishing wharf is still bustling with mooring lines, fish crates and chatter. The passage at the wharf is often flooded with seawater and entangled with fishing gear, so visitors should choose an observation angle from a public area to ensure safety and not hinder the work of fishermen. The atmosphere of the fishing wharf changes every hour according to the water and the sea season, creating a vivid patch of life that is constantly vivid.

sections.heading: From a small detail overlooking the estuary
sections.body:
The nose of the boat eyes arouse curiosity, but if you linger and watch longer, you will realize the magical rhythm of the whole estuary: the boats rhythmically following the channel, the hustle and bustle of loaders and the careful preparations for the ocean waves. Every rustic brushstroke and sweat drop on the harbor is the most authentic story of Phu Quoc island life. 

If the common point, canoes in Rach Gia, Phu Quoc and the Gulf of Thailand in the past possessed very characteristic eyes: round eyes, painted in black and red on a blue background. But with Phu Quoc, unlike the eyes of the boats facing directly to the distance of Can Duoc or An Giang, the eyes of Phu Quoc fishing boats are drawn looking down to the water. Fishermen believe that this direction of view helps boats easily detect deep fish streams and avoid coral reefs and reefs on the seabed of Pearl Island

sections.heading: Why is the eye of Phu Quoc boats gradually "disappearing"?
sections.body:
The disappearance of the eyes looking down on the bow of the Phu Quoc comes from the following practical reasons: 

* The dominance of steel-hulled and composite-hulled ships: Traditional wooden boats are gradually being replaced by modern composite ships or large steel-hulled vessels for offshore fishing. As materials change, mechanized shipbuilding techniques make shipbuilders no longer as salty with manual chiseling or eye painting as before. 

* Changes in navigation technology: In the past, fishermen relied on spirituality and experience to find the way. Today, Phu Quoc fishing boats are equipped with modern GPS locators, radars, and ultrasonic fish detectors. The eyes of the spiritual boat no longer play a unique role in "guiding the way" for fishermen. 

* The death of artisans "enlightening the eyes": The custom of painting the eyes of the boat requires experienced craftsmen to worship the gods before putting down the pen. When the older generation of artisans in Kien Giang died, the younger generation rarely learned this profession that required many abstinence rituals. 

* Commercialization and mass shipbuilding: Many cruise ships and night squid fishing boats serving visitors in Phu Quoc are hastily built according to industrial shapes, completely omitting the details of the boat eyes or only painting through the speakers, losing the inherent soul of "eyes looking at the sea" of Pearl Island. 

The fact that the eyes of Phu Quoc boats are gradually sparse on sea gates such as Duong Dong or An Thoi is a testament to the shift from river folklore to the industrialized era, leaving many nostalgia for those who love the beauty of ancient sea and island culture.

stories.title: Swirling back, not telling the whole story of Phu Quoc dogs
stories.dek: The ingrown fur strip on the back is the most famous identifying mark of the Phu Quoc dog, but the identity and ingenuity of this precious breed lie in many deeper values than that.
stories.intro: Seen from above, the swirling band running along the spine makes the Phu Quoc dog unmistakable. But to really feel the beauty of this native dog, you need to observe both the slender physique, the swimming legs, the quick reflexes and absolute loyalty. A beautiful swirl is a source of pride, but not all to talk about the origin and affection for them.
stories.image_alt: Phu Quoc dog, the island's native dog breed
stories.image_caption: Phu Quoc dog in Wikimedia Commons file photo.

sections.heading: Vortex and a whole breed of dog
sections.body:
The characteristic swirl band appears when the flaps of fur grow in the opposite direction compared to the hair on the back. According to the standards of breeder associations, a purebred Phu Quoc dog must fully converge elements of shape, skeleton, pointed ears and characteristic personality, not just based on the swirl mark. The legends about the ability to swim, hunt or climb of Phu Quoc dogs are real, but the dexterity of each individual also depends on the nurturing regime, habitat and patient training. 

On Phu Quoc Island, dogs are both close housekeepers for families and are raised at breeding farms. If you have the opportunity to visit breeding farms, you should learn about genealogy, health monitoring books and care procedures instead of just watching skill demonstrations. True health and flexibility can only be achieved when the dog lives in a natural and loving environment.

sections.heading: Visiting the camp, I see how the owner takes care of the dog
sections.body: When visiting the farm, take the time to observe the living space, water sources, and the caregiver's attitude towards the dogs. Always consult with the trainer before interacting or feeding the dog. The swirl band may be a brilliant first impression, but it's the ingenuity, loyalty, and way people appreciate the precious breed that lingers most deeply in the hearts of visitors.

stories.title: Dinh Cau before the sea trip
stories.dek: Located horizontally on the rocky rapids at the mouth of the Duong Dong River, Dinh Cau is not only a poetic sunset watching attraction, but also a solid spiritual fulcrum for many generations of fishermen before each time they set sail.
stories.intro: Located on a natural rocky outcrop reaching out to the open sea, Dinh Cau owns a beautiful view to welcome the sunset. But for families associated with life with the waves, this place is a sacred place to send faith and prayers for peace before the unexpected storms of the ocean.
stories.image_alt: Dinh Cau passage and gate seen from the coast of Duong Dong
stories.image_caption: Dinh Cau and the way up the rapids. Photo posted in the Outo handbook in 2024.

sections.heading: Prayers for Peace and Places of Worship
sections.body:
Dinh Cau is deeply blended into the spiritual life of the Phu Quoc fishing community. Each smell of incense smoke cannot replace a steady steering wheel or seafaring experience, but it is a spiritual fulcrum that strengthens those who go out to sea and soothes the longing of those who stay. Standing on the top of the rocky rapids watching the waves crashing at the mouth of the river, you will fully feel the harmony between the majestic nature and the rustic faith of people. 

This place has always been a respectful space for local residents. When visiting Dinh Cau, visitors should choose polite clothes, walk softly and give way to those who are doing the ceremony. Maintaining the solemn tranquility will help the relic space retain its original sacredness.

sections.heading: Overlooking the estuary
sections.body: From the public grounds around Dinh Cau, visitors can enjoy a panoramic view of the mouth of the Duong Dong River bustling with boats. The coastal rocky shores can be slippery due to waves and rocks crawling in the rainy season, so choose a safe place to enjoy the scenery. If you want to find a tranquil space to feel the depth of culture here, you can choose to visit Dinh Cau in the early morning when the sun is light.

stories.title: Fairy Well: stories and known things
stories.dek: The Tien well in Ong Doi Cape is a real landmark, associated with the legend of Lord Nguyen Anh looking for a source of fresh water. The separation between geographical and historical evidence makes the story more poetic.
stories.intro: Hidden on the cliff of Mui Ong Doi, Gieng Tien is a magical small freshwater geyser flowing close to the edge of the salty sea waves. Folklore has it that in the days of evading the Tay Son army, Lord Nguyen Anh drew his sword and pierced the jade rock and prayed, immediately a stream of cool fresh water erupted. The geyser and legend blend into one, creating a special charm for the land of the South Island.
stories.image_alt: Tien well and shrine on Ong Doi Cape, Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Water well and shrine at Ong Doi Cape.

sections.heading: Real places, stories with many variants
sections.body: The Tien Well is a real natural phenomenon, but the circumstances surrounding it are rich with many folklore variants. In folk memories and stories told to visitors, the traces of swords or footprints on the rocks are associated with the footsteps of Lord Nguyen. These legends carry profound folk consciousness, reflecting how the local community sends historical imprints into each scenic spot.

sections.heading: Putting historical figures in context
sections.body: The official histories record that Nguyen Anh once had a time to escape in the Phu Quoc island area. This is the authentic historical foundation that creates the background for the legend of the Tien Well. Appreciating folk anecdotes in parallel with an objective view of history will help us have a more comprehensive and deeper perspective on each time engraving on the island.

sections.heading: Arrive and listen to the narrator
sections.body: The road to Ong Doi Cape is currently under its own management area, visitors should check access information before scheduling. When listening to locals tell about different versions of Gieng Tien, enjoy it as a layer of colorful folklore. It is these oral stories that breathe life into every rock rapids and cliff of Phu Quoc.

stories.title: Rach Vem and starfish in the water
stories.dek: Rach Vem fascinates visitors by the image of brilliant red-orange starfish under the crystal clear water. However, their appearance depends entirely on the water, the weather and the seasonality of nature.
stories.intro: Some days when you set foot in Rach Vem, you will be surprised to see hundreds of bright red starfish scattered on the shallow water close to the shore. But there are also days when the shore is empty due to the tide or waves changing direction. When you are lucky enough to encounter these "ocean stars", the best way to appreciate them is to see and take photos right under the water.
stories.image_alt: Starfish in shallow water at Rach Vem beach, Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Starfish are observed in shallow water.

sections.heading: Conspicuous sprints, also vulnerable
sections.body:
At times of low sprint, starfish are clearly visible on the fine sand, but this is also when they are most vulnerable if the viewer accidentally steps on them. Walk carefully, pay attention to each step and keep a cherished distance. You can ask the locals to choose the most ideal viewing area without disturbing their ecosystem. 

Starfish breathe through delicate skin spines and are completely dependent on the water environment. The act of lifting starfish out of the water to take a photo or hold it can cause them to suffocate and die very quickly. Photos of starfish shimmering under crystal clear water always bring the most natural and civilized beauty.

sections.heading: Rach Vem still has things to see
sections.body: Whether you meet a starfish or not, Rach Vem still possesses a peaceful charm with coastal fishing villages, floating culinary rafts and a road through the shady forest of the North Island. The road to Rach Vem has a red dirt road that can be muddy after rain, so consulting traffic conditions in advance will help you have a complete and safe journey.

stories.title: Ham Ninh in the morning, the beach village before crowded time
stories.dek: Ham Ninh is not only famous for its specialty sweet boiled crab. This place is also an ancient fishing village that keeps the rustic rhythm of life by the dock, boats and batches of seafood early in the morning.
stories.intro: Welcoming the sunrise in Ham Ninh, visitors will be immersed in the real rhythm of working life: the sound of boats docking, the hustle and bustle of people and the strong aroma from the breakfast shops and kitchens. The rhythm of life here follows the water and sea breeze, completely unaffected by the tourist lifestyle.
stories.image_alt: People make nets at the pier in front of Ham Ninh village, Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Documents on Ham Ninh piers and marine crafts in 2002, not the current scene.

sections.heading: The image of the old bridge belonged to a time
sections.body: In the memories of many people through old photos, the long smoked wooden bridge reaching out to the sea used to be a legendary symbol of Ham Ninh. Now, the appearance of the fishing village has had more modern changes to serve the lives of residents and welcome visitors. If you want to find the old space again, open your heart to a new and lively Ham Ninh, where the sea and island culture still exist intact in every breath of everyday life.

sections.heading: Ham Ninh crab and how to order
sections.body: Ham Ninh crab is famous for its firm meat and natural rich sweetness. However, the size and quality of crabs may vary depending on each batch of boats. When enjoying seafood at raft houses, you should clearly discuss with the owner about the unit price by weight, raw or cooked weighing specifications, as well as the accompanying processing costs. Transparent communication will help make your meals more fun and comfortable.

sections.heading: Walk around the dining table
sections.body: After enjoying breakfast, take time to walk around the public harbor area to observe the daily life of fishermen. Pay attention to give way to workers transporting seafood and always ask permission before taking portraits. The true beauty of Ham Ninh lies in the diligent and sincere working life of the people here.

stories.title: At the night market, ask the price before calling
stories.dek: Duong Dong Night Market is a brilliant culinary paradise with countless stalls of fragrant grilled seafood. A little experience on how to ask prices and choose dishes will help you have a complete dinner.
stories.intro: Entering the night market, visitors are immediately attracted by the smell of charcoal grilled seafood and the colorful bustling atmosphere. For the most complete culinary experience, you should spend a few minutes walking around the stalls, actively asking carefully how to calculate the price of seafood before choosing a table to sit down.
stories.image_alt: Fresh seafood is sold at Phu Quoc night market
stories.image_caption: Seafood stall at Phu Quoc night market.

sections.heading: How is seafood calculated?
sections.body: When consulting fresh seafood stalls, don't hesitate to ask how the weight is calculated: the price is applied to raw seafood in the tank or after cleaning, and whether it includes processing fees (grilling, steaming, stir-frying). For complex dishes or going in large groups, ask the staff to confirm the quantity and total estimated cost. Asking for detailed prices is a civilized consumption habit, helping both customers and stall owners understand each other.

sections.heading: Choose dishes according to the table
sections.body: Choosing a variety of menus will enrich the meal: combine steamed dishes that retain their natural sweetness, grilled onion fat and a hot pot of seafood for the whole group to sip. You can order a few typical dishes in advance, enjoy them and order more if necessary to keep the food hot. If there are members who have seafood allergies, please immediately notify the waiter so that the kitchen will pay attention to the processing separately.

sections.heading: Going to the market in winter
sections.body: During the evening rush hour, the atmosphere of the night market is very crowded. If you are traveling with young children or the elderly, please keep a safe distance and make an appointment in advance of the meeting point in case you get lost. Be a little observant in how to move and choose, you will have an evening of night market culinary experience full of fun.

stories.title: An Thoi, a sea town in the south of the island
stories.dek: An Thoi is the starting point of journeys to explore the enchanting An Thoi archipelago. Behind the busy tourist piers is a seaport town rich in local cultural vitality.
stories.intro: For many tourists, An Thoi is merely a transit place to get on a canoe to explore small islands, where there is a Sunset town or take the modern Hon Thom cable car. But if you stop a little longer, you will discover a busy An Thoi with traditional seafood markets, long-standing eateries and a rich life rhythm of the sea flavor of the South Island.
stories.image_alt: An Thoi fishing village, Phu Quoc in 2015
stories.image_caption: A corner of An Thoi fishing village on 27/02/2015. Documentary photo of a coastal residential area, not describing the operation of the port today.

sections.heading: Canoe tours, squid fishing boats for tourists
sections.body:
In An Thoi, there are two popular means of waterway for tourists: canoes/cruise ships specializing in taking guests to experience small island tours or large boats fishing for seasonal squid. Each type uses a separate wharf area. When booking the service, you should check the exact name of the port and the meeting time on the confirmation ticket to avoid confusion. 

Gathering on time at the wharf not only makes the trip smooth but also ensures that maritime safety procedures are fully implemented. Please always wear a life jacket according to the instructions of the crew. The itinerary to explore small islands can be flexibly adjusted according to turbulent conditions to ensure absolute safety for visitors.

sections.heading: "Town" outside the tour schedule
sections.body: Stepping out of the bustling atmosphere of tourist ports, An Thoi opens up bustling streets with fishing markets filled with fresh seafood and authentic local eateries. Spending a short time enjoying a bowl of vermicelli or walking around the port town area will give you authentic and insightful views of the South Island.

stories.title: Bai Sao changes by the hour and season
stories.dek: Bai Sao is famous for its creamy white sand and jade water. However, the beauty of this beach always changes magically according to the seasons of wind, tide and sunshine during the day.
stories.intro: Promotional photos often capture the clearest moment of Bai Sao, but in fact, the beauty here is a living entity that is constantly changing. Depending on the southeast or southwest wind season, the tide rises and falls, the sea surface is sometimes calm like a sheet, sometimes abundant with waves. Grasping the rhythm of nature will help you choose the time to enjoy the sea to the fullest.
stories.image_alt: Phu Quoc Star Beach at sunshine
stories.image_caption: Sao Beach with bright sand and coconut rows.

sections.heading: The same beach, the sea may be different
sections.body: Located on the southeast coast of Phu Quoc Island, Bai Sao is directly influenced by the directions of the monsoon. There are times when the sea is calm and clear to see the bottom, but there are also seasons when large waves bring natural seaweed to the shore. Before immersing yourself in the cool water, you should observe the safety flag and ask the beach staff about the suitable swimming area.

sections.heading: Choosing the Right Shore
sections.body: Bai Sao stretches with many different service areas, restaurants, and access to the sea. When making an appointment for a pick-up service, remember the name of the restaurant or the specific entrance for easy positioning. Services such as parachute chair rental, freshwater bath or water sports have different prices depending on the management unit, so asking the price before using the service is a habit to have.

sections.heading: Change the plan when the sea is not suitable
sections.body: If the weather or the water of the day is not favorable for swimming, you can still enjoy Bai Sao in your own relaxing way: stroll along the fine sand, enjoy a glass of cool water under the shade of coconuts or watch the vast ocean. The flexibility in the experience always brings the most complete satisfaction to the trip.

stories.title: Beautiful Painting Stream according to the water season
stories.dek: The beauty of Suoi Tranh changes miraculously according to each season of the year: the rainy season pours water happily among the thousands, the dry season reveals the amazing moss rocks under the canopy of the primeval forest.
stories.intro: Suoi Tranh wears two completely different appearances according to the seasons. The rainy season brings a cool swirling stream of water singing through the rapids; when the dry season comes, the stream shrinks to reveal uniquely shaped rocks and swaying forest vegetation. No matter what season you visit, Suoi Tranh still offers visitors fresh air and the gentle murmur of nature.
stories.image_alt: Suoi Tranh waterfall on Phu Quoc island
stories.image_caption: A section of the waterfall in Suoi Tranh, Wikimedia Commons file photo.

sections.heading: Water Flow and Rock Path
sections.body:
The Suoi Tranh stream originates from high ravines in deep forests, so the water flow directly depends on the upstream rains. When the heavy rain has just stopped, the water flow can rise quickly and flow rapidly; visitors need to obey safety warning signs and stay away from slippery deep water areas. Enjoying the view of the stream from safe locations on the shore is always a smart choice. 

The paths along the stream are natural stone steps that can be covered with wet moss. You should prepare a pair of sneakers that grip well, watch every step carefully, and always keep an eye on young children. Let's help protect the environment by not littering and carefully storing personal items.

sections.heading: In the dry season, there is still something to see
sections.body: In the dry season, although the stream is not overflowing with water, it opens up a great opportunity to explore the unique topography of the stream bed with winding ancient tree roots and all shapes of mountain rocks. Understanding and appreciating the original beauty of Suoi Tranh in each season will make your trekking more poetic.

stories.title: Phu Quoc forest holds the island's waterways
stories.dek: The vast green area of Phu Quoc National Park is not only a green lung, but also a "natural purifier" that stores and regulates invaluable fresh water for the entire Pearl Island.
stories.intro: Every drop of rain that falls on the canopy of the primeval forest in the North of the island begins a magical journey. The forest retains rainwater, filters through each layer of soil and nourishes the groundwater, flowing into small streams that pour into rivers and seas. Protecting primeval forests is protecting a sustainable source of life for people and ecosystems on the island.
stories.image_alt: Evergreen forests on Phu Quoc island
stories.image_caption: A section of evergreen forest on Phu Quoc Island.

sections.heading: From forest land to the sea mouth
sections.body: The dense foliage and decaying vegetation in the forest act as a giant sponge, helping to reduce the rate of rainwater runoff, prevent landslides, and retain precious freshwater. From here, groundwater permeates the rivers, streams and domestic water sources of the entire community. The integrity of the primeval forest is directly related to the survival of the island.

sections.heading: Not all trails are open to visitors
sections.body: Phu Quoc National Park is divided into many strict conservation areas with its own management regulations. The trails on the map are not always for free travel. To experience forest trekking safely and in accordance with regulations, visitors should accompany a professional guide and strictly follow the instructions of the local Forest Ranger.

sections.heading: Go slow to recognize the little things
sections.body: Take a slow walk through the forest to feel the natural world come alive: the sound of birds singing on the tall trees, fancy mushrooms, carpets of fine green moss, and small streams that weave through the roots of the trees. Listening to the breath of the forest and leaving nothing but footprints is the most civilized way to be grateful to nature.

stories.title: Phu Quoc Prison: reading relics in context
stories.dek: The Phu Quoc Prison Historical Site is a silent testimony marking the pages of tragic history. Learning about history through timelines and distinguishing the original artifacts from the re-enactment space will help visitors have a deep and respectful perspective.
stories.intro: Setting foot in the Phu Quoc Prison Relic Area, visitors cannot help but be moved by the images and models that recreate history. To fully appreciate the value of the relic, take the time to carefully read the signs, learn the historical context through each period and clearly distinguish between the original documents and the restoration models for sightseeing.
stories.image_alt: Documents of An Thoi prison on Phu Quoc island, 1968
stories.image_caption: Historical documentary photo of An Thoi prison, 1968.

sections.heading: Coconut Tree Stretch and Prisoner of War Camp
sections.body: The history of the relic goes through many important stages, from the Coconut Tree Stretch period built by French colonialists to the later Vietnam Prisoner of War Prison Camp. Each period has its own architectural features and historical context. Carefully reading the timelines at the entrance will help visitors systematize their knowledge accurately and completely.

sections.heading: Artifacts and re-enactments
sections.body: The monument grounds include surviving original works, battlefield memorabilia, and subdivisions recreated with cement statue models. The reconstruction models aim to visualize the harsh conditions of detention in the past. Visitors should carefully read the annotated boards to distinguish between museum artifacts and simulated spaces.

sections.heading: A place to be visited with respect
sections.body: A visit to a historical site is a deep emotional journey that requires a solemn attitude and appreciation of history. Walk lightly, speak softly, and keep a dignified space for everyone around you. Listening to historical stories with an open heart will help us appreciate the value of peace today even more.

stories.title: Hon Thom cable car: see the archipelago from above
stories.dek: The Hon Thom cable car route offers a spectacular experience when capturing the panoramic view of the emerald green An Thoi archipelago from the air. A complete trip requires preparation in terms of schedule and weather.
stories.intro: As soon as the cable car cabin leaves An Thoi station and reaches out into the air, the vast blue ocean immediately opens up at the feet of visitors. From an overhead view, undulating islands, brilliant fishing boats and magical color-changing water layers appear vividly like a work of art of nature.
stories.image_alt: Hon Thom cable car crosses the southern sea of Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Hon Thom cable car seen from above.

sections.heading: From the cabin to Hon Thom
sections.body:
On sunny days, from the cabin you can take in the view of the coral reefs sparkling under the transparent water. When clouds or showers suddenly interrupt, the scenery has a magical blur. Take the moment to relax and watch the vast ocean instead of just recording through the glass. The change of sunlight and clouds will bring completely new visual emotions throughout the journey. 

Entertainment areas on Hon Thom Island have separate operating hours. You should actively check the operating schedule of the return cable car route to arrange a reasonable time to play, eat and rest, especially when traveling with families with elderly people and children.

sections.heading: Follow the instructions at the cable car
sections.body: Operating the cable car across the sea always complies with strict safety standards, which can be paused when encountering bad weather or high winds. Please always listen to the instructions of the operator, keep your personal belongings carefully. Enjoy the trip with a relaxed attitude that will bring you memorable moments on the air floor of Pearl Island.

stories.title: Noodle soup and homemade dipping cups
stories.dek: Phu Quoc vermicelli is attractive because of the hot bowl of vermicelli and the experience of "stirring" the dipping bowl with your own hands.
stories.intro: A complete bowl of vermicelli is served with freshly squeezed noodles, shrimp cakes, fish cakes, and hot broth. Next to it is a spice counter for each person to make their own dipping bowl according to their taste, then taste and adjust a little before eating.
stories.image_alt: A bowl of Phu Quoc vermicelli eaten with a cup of dipping sauce
stories.image_caption: Phu Quoc vermicelli in the food article of the Phu Quoc Special Zone People's Committee; used to illustrate the general dish, not representing a specific restaurant.

sections.heading: Stir the dipping cups according to taste
sections.body: The bowl of vermicelli dipping does not have a fixed recipe between restaurants. The tackle, chili, sugar and spices are prepared for the diner to mix, taste and adjust according to taste. Dipping a piece of pork rolls before pouring more into the bowl will make it easier to control the acidity, spiciness and darkness.

sections.heading: Cooked patties in a hot bowl
sections.body: The characteristic feature of vermicelli is that the shrimp and fish cakes are thinly squeezed into the sides of the bowl and then the broth is boiled so that the pork is cooked on the spot. The vermicelli fibers are also pressed directly from fresh rice flour into a pot of broth. Enjoy it as soon as the bowl of vermicelli is still hot to fully feel the chewiness of the vermicelli and the original sweetness of the seafood.

sections.heading: Taste the bowl before adding seasoning
sections.body: Before adding more dipping sauce to the bowl, try a spoonful of the original broth to feel the natural sweetness of fresh fish and shrimp. Depending on your taste, you can scoop some dipping sauce directly or dip each piece of patties. If you have a history of allergies to shrimp, squid or sea fish, you should discuss with the staff in advance to prepare the most suitable bowl of vermicelli.

stories.title: Duong Dong estuary, where fish boats enter and exit
stories.dek: The mouth of the Duong Dong River is a trading post, where fishing boats hurriedly reach out to sea and return right in the heart of the island. Depending on the water, the flow of boats and the rhythm of the wharf, the scenery here always changes vividly from hour to hour.
stories.intro: Standing from the shore overlooking the mouth of the Duong Dong River, you will see the picture of the sea when it is busy with boats tail-to-tail landing at the dock, sometimes sparse and quiet drifting with the rhythm of the water. Hidden behind that scenery is the dominance of the water, the weather and the busy schedule of each train. The estuary is not only the place where fresh water flows into the big sea, but also the daily livelihood pulse of many people living around the center of Pearl Island.
stories.image_alt: Duong Dong estuary flows into Phu Quoc sea
stories.image_caption: Duong Dong estuary, Wikimedia Commons file photo.

sections.heading: The water changes, the wharf is still working
sections.body:
Heavy rains can cloudy the river, while the tide diligently regulates the water level up and down every day. Boat owners must skillfully guard the channel and the right time to enter and exit, so even though the water seems calm, this is still not a safe place for visitors to swim on their own. If you want to enjoy the scenery, you just need to choose a safe corner in a public area, pay attention to the slippery edges of the wharf and observe the rhythm of boats passing by. 

As soon as the boat lands, the fishing wharf immediately bursts into bustle: the person passing the fish, the person transferring the cold ice, the person tying the anchor line or hurriedly preparing for the next trip. On the dock, the mooring line can squeeze across the aisle, the floor is slippery, and the cart is constantly going back and forth. Standing at a sufficient distance, you can still capture this livelihood in plain sight; but if you want to photograph the workers, politely ask for permission and be careful not to obstruct their delivery aisles.

sections.heading: View of the estuary from the shore
sections.body: The mouth of the Duong Dong River has days when the boats are constantly busy, but there are also days when the wharf is more busy because of the weather and the changing schedule of the sea. Instead of trying to crowd close to the water's edge to take pictures, choosing a safe location on the shore, leisurely watching the boats winding with the water flow will help you feel the rhythm of life here more clearly and peacefully. Chatting with fish sellers or water bar owners around the wharf, asking about the return time is also an interesting way for you to understand more about the soul of this fishing wharf.

stories.title: Fish Ong in the belief of seafarers
stories.dek: Seafarers always pay special respect when calling whales Ca Ong. In Phu Quoc, the legends of the savior in the middle of the sea, the solemn mausoleums and the Nghinh Ong ceremony have crystallized into the lifelong spiritual beliefs of the fishing community.
stories.intro: In the midst of all kinds of waves, seafarers always call whales by a respectful name: Ca Ong. Anecdotes about whales protecting and rescuing boats in distress and the wish for a safe return have accompanied coastal life for many generations. Coming to Phu Quoc, that sacred belief is still clearly visible in the silent mausoleums and through the occasions of bustling community festivals.
stories.image_alt: Fishing vessels near Phu Quoc port in 2025
stories.image_caption: Fishing boats near Phu Quoc port in 2025. Photo of the background of seafarers; not a photo of a Ca Ong shrine.

sections.heading: A name that carries gratitude
sections.body: In the oral narration of seafarers, whales often transform into brave saviors, sheltering fishermen in the midst of storms offshore. It is the cultural memory and beliefs of a community, not merely a description of the biological characteristics of this fish. Fishermen tell stories with life-and-death experiences and deep gratitude; while science has its own approach to explaining the behavior of these giant marine creatures.

sections.heading: Mausoleum and Nghinh Ong ceremony
sections.body: The cult of Ca Ong is carefully preserved by the community through mausoleums filled with thousands of smoky incense and especially through the traditional Nghinh Ong festival. Depending on each locality and each year, the time of the procession, the procession ritual or the scale of the festival may have different features. If you want to immerse yourself in this sacred atmosphere, you should follow the announcement from the local organizers or directly ask the people, avoiding rigidly relying on old schedules online.

sections.heading: Visit a Religious Space
sections.body: The mausoleum is a sacred spiritual place, where people come to worship. Therefore, when visiting, visitors need to keep quiet, choose polite and discreet clothes and always ask permission before wanting to take pictures. You can hear many variations about the legend of Ca Ong, enjoy the diversity of folklore without having to determine which story is the most correct. The reverence for this animal should also be extended to the open sea: absolutely do not chase, touch or disturb whales when they encounter them in the natural environment.

stories.title: What does "Pearl Island" suggest about Phu Quoc?
stories.dek: "Pearl Island" is a familiar beauty of Phu Quoc, evoking the image of the blue sea and precious products. However, the real soul that creates the island is still hidden in the old forests, rustic villages and the pace of life is changing day by day.
stories.intro: Referring to Phu Quoc, many people will immediately utter the words "Pearl Island" - a beautiful name that has been memorized in countless travel guides. That name evokes the sparkling beauty of the ocean and the abundance of products, but in fact it is not an administrative name or a geological definition. Only when wandering through quiet villages, weaving among green pepper gardens or entering deep forests do we realize that that nickname only tells part of the story of this island.
stories.image_alt: A beach in Phu Quoc at the end of 2025
stories.image_caption: A real beach in Phu Quoc, taken on 28/12/2025. The photo only illustrates the scenery of the island, does not explain the origin of the nickname "Pearl Island".

sections.heading: Two evocative words, many layers of life
sections.body:
The blue sea, white sand and gifts from the sea have made the name 'Pearl Island' a symbol of Phu Quoc in countless promotional campaigns. However, the journey to discover Phu Quoc also takes you to the primeval forests, peaceful villages, passionate pepper gardens, fishing life and livelihood jobs that are changing day by day. That beautiful name can paint a brilliant first impression, but to fully understand the island, you have to turn it through each layer of life yourself. 

Located along the West Coast are beautiful stretches of beaches, translating to the North is the vast national forest, turning to Ham Ninh, you will encounter a rustic fishing village along the bank, and right at the mouth of the Duong Dong River, the fishing boats are still bustling day and night. Each coordinate opens a new lens. If the schedule allows, instead of just racing to check-in famous tourist attractions, stop to visit a small village or sit and listen to the muddy foot workers tell life stories and career stories.

sections.heading: Preserving what makes the island precious
sections.body: The two words 'Pearl Island' evoke appreciation, and the journey to protect the pristine island sometimes only begins with the very ordinary actions of a trip. Just let the starfish be peaceful in the water, avoid stepping on fragile coral reefs and always respect the living space of the local people. These small, practical actions have a deeper pervasiveness and conservation meaning than ten thousand clichés about the beauty of the island.

stories.title: Buying Phu Quoc fish sauce, how to read the label correctly?
stories.dek: Although it bears the same name Phu Quoc, fish sauce has geographical indications and traditional fish sauce have different definitions. Be equipped with an accurate label reading before deciding to choose a bottle of fish sauce that suits your taste.
stories.intro: Glancing through the barrel houses with the smell of salty anchovies, then standing in front of the vast fish sauce counter, many people are confused: which bottle is the right Phu Quoc fish sauce standard? The answer does not lie in the darkness of the color or the sky-high protein number. The first key is that you must understand the words that are formally printed on the label.
stories.image_alt: Wooden barrels brewing anchovies at a fish sauce factory in Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Anchovies compost barrels at a Phu Quoc barrel house, file photo in 2015.

sections.heading: Two calls, two things to understand
sections.body: The Phu Quoc fish sauce brand has been granted a certificate of geographical indication protection in Vietnam since 2001 and was officially registered in the European Union in 2012. However, according to the Local Technical Regulations issued in 2023, there is a clear delineation between "Phu Quoc geographical indication fish sauce" and "Phu Quoc traditional fish sauce". Each name comes with its own set of strict standards for input materials, fermentation process, and finished product quality. Remember, these are legal and technical norms, not a taste ranking of which bottle is better than another.

sections.heading: What to look for if you want to buy a type with geographical indications?
sections.body: To be sure to buy the right fish sauce with a geographical indication, look for a specific logo and carefully read the name, address of the production facility and other mandatory information on the bottle label. It should be noted that the words "Phu Quoc traditional fish sauce" do not automatically mean that the product is labeled with a geographical indication. On the contrary, just a glance at a corner of the packaging is not enough basis to evaluate the entire product. If you are still worried, do not hesitate to ask the manufacturer directly or look up information from the geographical indication management board.

sections.heading: After all, it is still a bottle of fish sauce suitable for meals
sections.body: Everyone's taste is different: some people are addicted to fish sauce that smells like pure anchovies to make raw dipping sauce, others prefer a milder flavor to taste when cooking. Although the protein index is a useful reference measure, it cannot fully describe the aroma, sweetness or the most ideal combination. If you choose fish sauce as a gift, you should carefully check the content, sealing stamp, ingredient list and storage instructions. Especially, for people who abstain from fish or have allergies, it is paramount to examine the label before closing the order.

stories.title: In Phu Quoc forest, there are trees registered as heritage
stories.dek: From the first 6 ancient trees to be honored in 2025, to May 2026, Phu Quoc National Park is proud to welcome 14 more trees and 2 plant populations to the list of Heritage Trees. Each name is a precious piece of the old forest that needs to be strictly protected.
stories.intro: Stepping into the space of Phu Quoc National Park, the vast green color immediately covers the eye. There, the towering ancient tree trunks and soaring foliage often slow down the footsteps of travelers. Many of the trees here have been engraved on the list of Vietnamese Heritage Trees, and from 2026, that pride is no longer limited to single individuals.
stories.image_alt: Evergreen forest canopy in Phu Quoc, background photo is not a nominal heritage tree
stories.image_caption: Evergreen forests in Phu Quoc. Background photos, not photos identifying heritage trees in the article.

sections.heading: Six Opening Trees
sections.body: March 2025 marks a historical milestone when six majestic ancient trees in Phu Quoc National Park are named Vietnamese Heritage Trees. They are two Southern mussel trees proudly reaching out at Bai Thom, along with two konia trees and two muscular trees rooted in Ganh Dau. These are the first "elders" of Kien Giang province to be honored to receive this noble title. Because the lifespan of trees has differences through different accounts or records, we do not need to "nail" each tree with an absolutely unagreed number.

sections.heading: By May 2026: 20 trees and two populations
sections.body: May 29, 2026 continues to make a proud mark when the National Park is officially honored with 14 single trees and two superficial plant populations. Through this announcement, the Park's natural treasures have been raised to 20 distinct heritage trees and two vibrant heritage populations. These plant collections not only tell the story of the ups and downs of the sacred forest, but also reflect the biodiversity picture of ecosystems that need to be preserved, ranging from large timber forests to mangrove bogs.

sections.heading: Registration does not mean opening the sightseeing trail
sections.body: Heritage certificates are not a tourist map that invites visitors to massively find each stump. The area where the heritage trees are located is still in the core area that is strictly protected and controlled by the National Park Management Board. If you are an enthusiast of field research, please contact the Management Board directly to ask for permission to access through the designated routes and must be accompanied by an expert guide. Admiring a perennial tree is a privilege, but protecting it so that it continues to take root and stretch its branches in the heart of the deep forest is an eternal mission.

stories.title: Phu Quoc instant fish sauce, from a cup of green mango to a meal
stories.dek: Conveniently seasoned fish sauce is the soul of fruit plates, boiled meat grains or stir-fried stews. With the esoteric spice recipes of each establishment, each jar of fish sauce brings a completely different taste experience.
stories.intro: Sometimes, a plate of green mango or crispy toad only really "tops" when it is dipped with a little rich fish sauce. In Phu Quoc, in addition to the traditional version of fish sauce used to season rice trays, people also create an extremely convenient instant fish sauce, just open the lid and you can enjoy it immediately. Although the name "instant fish sauce" is the same, each jar contains its own levels of salty, sweet, and spicy taste, making this simple specialty rich.
stories.image_alt: Seaweed harvested in Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Seaweed after harvesting in Phu Quoc. The photo illustrates local ingredients, not a brand's packaging product.

sections.heading: Sea flies and familiar spices
sections.body: The journey of a jar of fish sauce starts with batches of fresh sea flies brewed with salt, then added sugar, chili, minced lemongrass or fried garlic to produce an instant version. There are jars with a dense aroma of fish sauce, and there are jars that stand out with their smooth sweetness and stimulating spiciness. That is the quintessence of each fish sauce maker, there is absolutely no common pattern representing all fish sauce products on Phu Quoc island. If you are curious to know what flavor you are going to taste, the fastest way is to carefully read the ingredients on the label.

sections.heading: Dip the fruit, serve with boiled meat, add to stir-fry
sections.body: Instant fish sauce is often a good "co-star" of plates of toad, mango, crispy and sour guava or thinly sliced boiled meat. Not only that, just dot a little fish sauce in a pan of stir-fries or a pot of braised meat, the dish will immediately explode with rich flavor. When bringing it to your kitchen, you should taste it a little before rushing to add sugar, salt or chili. Because the fish sauce is already seasoned, if you still carelessly use the same amount as pure mussels, the dish is very easy to overdo, becoming unexpectedly salty or sweet.

sections.heading: Buy it as a gift, remember to read the label correctly
sections.body: When choosing fish sauce as a gift, don't be blinded by huge jars of fish sauce or gorgeous packaging. Be alert to carefully consider the place of production, ingredient list, expiration date, tightness of the lid and storage notes right on the product. In particular, because sea mussels are a type of crustacean, people with allergies need to read the ingredients carefully before tasting them. Choosing jars with a moderate capacity will be much more convenient, especially when you are just buying them to try them for the first time.

stories.title: Ripe pepper with sugar, a spice that is both spicy and sweet of Phu Quoc
stories.dek: The subtle combination of cooked peppers, sugar, fish sauce and esoteric spices creates a thick candy sauce. Whether it's a topping for a plate of boiled vegetables or seasoning it in a pot of braised fish, a small jar of sweet pepper with sugar always knows how to satisfy all tastes.
stories.intro: Phu Quoc pepper is not only famous for its black pepper branches or spicy ground pepper. The people on the island also create a famous specialty: ripe pepper with sugar - a comparable spice, smelling of fragrant pepper, delicately intertwined between salty and sweet taste. Opening the lid of the jar lightly, you immediately have an excellent multi-purpose dipping sauce or seasoning. Hearing the name, you think it's only pepper and sugar, but the real soul of the dish lies in the mixing secret of each production facility.
stories.image_alt: Freshly harvested pepper in Phu Quoc in 2015
stories.image_caption: Pepper has just been harvested at a Phu Quoc gardener in 2015. Photo of raw materials, not the brand's packaging products.

sections.heading: Ripe pepper meets sugar and fish sauce
sections.body: A common process is to grind or pound the pepper, mix it with sugar and fish sauce, then simmer over low heat, stirring evenly until the candy mixture is smooth. Some pepper makers also season with a little sea salt or other secret spices. As a result, the finished product does not have the pungent taste of pure ground pepper; the spiciness of the pepper at this time has been softened by the balanced sweet saltiness that has been tasted beforehand. The blending ratio between the main ingredients is the unique culinary art of each family.

sections.heading: Dip boiled dishes or season in a pot of braised fish
sections.body: Just scoop a small spoonful of sweet pepper with sugar to dip with boiled meat or boiled vegetables and you have a rustic meal. In rich braised dishes such as braised fish or braised meat, you can season it little by little into the pot, taste it and then decide whether to add sugar or fish sauce. Believers who are fascinated by the unique spicy and aromatic taste can even vary it by dipping it with sour fruits. Because the jar has a full convergence of sweet and spicy salty flavors, you should not use it in the right proportions like when using regular ground pepper.

sections.heading: Distinguishing sweet pepper from pure pepper
sections.body: If your goal is to sprinkle pepper on the surface of the dish to get the original spicy aroma, aim directly for pure ground pepper or pepper products. On the other hand, sweet pepper will be a true love if you want to reserve a versatile seasoning that is both salty, sweet and faintly spicy to make a dipping sauce. When choosing to buy, carefully examine the ingredient list, origin, expiration date and storage; especially those who are allergic to fish also need to be careful if the product contains fish sauce. Since each jar of pepper is a unique style of seasoning, tasting to find the "true love" that suits your taste is the most important thing.

stories.title: Bring a motorbike to Phu Quoc: book a seat before leaving the port
stories.dek: Holding a passenger ticket in your hand, your "pet driver" also has a seat on the train or ferry. If you intend to travel to Phu Quoc with your own motorbike, it is a must to "lock" the seat for the car and the process of sending the vehicle early.
stories.intro: The experience of exploring every corner of Phu Quoc on my familiar motorbike sounds fascinating. However, don't rush to pay for a person ticket and then remember to ask for a seat for the car. The ability to pick up a vehicle and the parking process vary depending on the company, route and trip, so confirming this information should be a priority from the very beginning of planning the trip.
stories.image_alt: Thanh Thoi ferry terminal in Phu Quoc with wharf and waiting house
stories.image_caption: Thanh Thoi ferry terminal in Phu Quoc, photo of the ferry terminal; not the scene of putting a motorbike on the ferry.

sections.heading: Select a pick-up ride
sections.body: High-speed trains should not be assumed to only carry people, nor should they be accepted by default on every trip. Some high-speed boats accept motorbikes with a limited number of seats; while high-speed ferries can carry both motorbikes, cars, and cargo depending on the brand. Therefore, before buying a passenger ticket, check the right brand, the right route, the right type of vehicle and ask if there is room for the vehicle. For cars, you need to choose a ferry with pick-up; for motorbikes, both high-speed boats and ferries can be optional options.

sections.heading: Ask three things when booking
sections.body: When loading and contacting the shipping company or ferry, clearly provide the departure date, sector, vehicle segment/type, and total number of passengers. Don't forget to ask carefully what the booking process is for the car, what the paperwork is required and how long you need to be at the port before departure. Always remember to keep all booking confirmation codes for both passengers and vehicles. In case of traveling in a group with multiple vehicles, inform the specific number at the beginning so that the airline can arrange and check the capacity.

sections.heading: Don't forget the return trip
sections.body: The operating schedule of ships and ferries may be postponed or changed due to the influence of weather, tides or operating adjustments from the airline. Before the departure date, it is never superfluous to double-check the information of the trip and return trip on the official channels. If you choose to run out of seats for motorbikes, you still have option B: leave the car at the parking lot on the mainland, buy a train ticket to the island and then rent a motorbike in Phu Quoc. Don't forget to consider the total cost of parking and the time to travel to the port to choose the right option.

stories.title: Under the water of Phu Quoc, there are also grasslands
stories.dek: Hidden deep under the shallow waters along the coast of Phu Quoc are green seagrass beds, which incubate life and provide shelter for countless species of creatures. (The article uses images of Phu Quoc coast combined with illustrations of seagrass from other landmarks, with clear notes).
stories.intro: When zooming in from the sandy shore, the picture of Phu Quoc sea often appears with clear water, white sand and distant islands. But few people know that, hidden under that shallow water is a vast seagrass steppe. They may not possess vibrant colors like coral reefs, but they are an invaluable ecological cradle, where the life cycle of many marine species originates.
stories.image_alt: The northern beach of Ham Ninh on the east coast of Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: The coast near Ham Ninh, Phu Quoc in 2015. Background photo of the coastal area, not a photo of underwater seagrass.

sections.heading: Real grass, living under the sea
sections.body: Seagrasses are completely different from seaweed; they are higher plants with a full structure of roots, leaf stems, flowers, and seeds. The root system of seagrass clings to the ocean floor, while the soft foliage rises to form "miniature forests", providing a safe haven for schools of juvenile fish and many invertebrates. Moreover, these grasses also play an important role in fixing sediment and protecting the coastline. Please don't pull or trample on the grass just out of curiosity; because that seemingly monotonous patch of grass is the common home of a whole miniature ecosystem.

sections.heading: What period does the figure of 652 hectares talk about?
sections.body: A study published in 2023 has painstakingly compared data from satellite and aerial images of 2005, 2010, 2018, combined with direct field surveys in 2019. The results show that, within the scope of the study, the area of Phu Quoc seagrass has shrunk by about 652 hectares, equivalent to 6.1% in the period from 2005 to 2018; in which, Bai Vong sea is the area that suffers the most losses. It should be noted that this is a data picture of a historical period that has passed, this figure should not be cited as a data reflecting the current state of the seagrass bed at the time of 2026.

sections.heading: Want to know how seagrass is today
sections.body: Another scientific study published in 2026 has conducted a detailed assessment of coverage, biomass, species composition and ecological environment at 16 monitoring stations in 4 island areas off the coast of Vietnam, with Phu Quoc being one of them. This sends a clear message: just one statistical map is not enough to make a comprehensive judgment of the "health" of seagrass beds. To have an accurate answer whether a grass is gradually reviving or is still under pressure, scientists need to conduct surveys in the right area, at the right time and maintain continuous monitoring over the years. When participating in marine activities, visitors should be aware of keeping a safe distance from sensitive ecosystems, and especially never allow to drop or pull anchors indiscriminately on the seagrass bed.

stories.title: Melaleuca mushroom soup, a dish according to the early rains of the season
stories.dek: The melaleuca mushroom season comes and goes very quickly. From the initial slight bitterness, through the varied hands of each chef, the bowl of melaleuca mushroom soup mixed with chicken or seafood will become extraordinarily sweet and attractive.
stories.intro: In the culinary world, there are specialties that are only revealed in their right season. And Phu Quoc melaleuca mushrooms are a gift from heaven and earth like that. Only after the early season rains cool the forest, melaleuca mushrooms spurt up from the damp rotten leaves. Freshly picked mushrooms carry a characteristic bitter taste, but when released into the soup pot, the bitter taste gives way to a sweet broth, creating a unique culinary flavor of the Pearl Island.
stories.image_alt: Bowl of melaleuca mushroom soup with seafood
stories.image_caption: Melaleuca mushroom soup cooked with seafood, a way to prepare seasonal mushroom dishes in Phu Quoc.

sections.heading: Fresh mushrooms are not always available
sections.body: Melaleuca mushrooms usually only bloom for a very short period of time after heavy rains. The timing of mushroom growth and the harvest yield each year is entirely up to the judgment of the "mother of nature", so don't expect that you can enjoy fresh melaleuca mushrooms at any month of the year. When you see a restaurant offering melaleuca mushroom soup, ask them directly if they are cooking with freshly picked mushrooms, pre-prepared mushrooms that have been preserved in cold storage, or some other type of mushroom.

sections.heading: The soup pot in each house is different
sections.body: The bowl of melaleuca mushroom soup in each kitchen has a different shape and flavor: some families like to cook it with delicious chewy chicken, some families like to add fresh shrimp, crispy squid or crab meat; some places even break the way to cook mushrooms with fish cakes and eggs. The sweet broth from meat ingredients rather than seafood has cleverly softened the slight bitterness of melaleuca mushrooms, while the mushroom body still retains an extremely crunchy and crunchy taste. There is no one melaleuca mushroom recipe that is standard for all. If this is your first time trying this dish, don't be afraid to ask the restaurant what ingredients the soup bowl is cooked with today so that you can easily choose according to your culinary taste.

sections.heading: Let the bitterness be just enough
sections.body: To eliminate the bitter taste, some chefs have the habit of boiling mushrooms in boiling water before adding them to cook soup. Mushrooms need to be cooked over fire to keep their characteristic crispiness. Diners with a history of allergies to shrimp, fish, squid or eggs should be especially careful to ask carefully about the ingredients for cooking the broth, because a seemingly frugal bowl of mushroom soup can contain a lot of seafood. And a very important rule: absolutely do not pick any strange mushrooms in the forest for cooking if you do not have an expert with you to accurately assess that it is melaleuca mushroom.

stories.title: Honey tacos, the cake looks like the wrapper knows how to wrap it
stories.dek: With narrow leaf plates and sturdy leaf veins, conquering the gall leaves to create a triangular taco requires the worker to possess extremely skillful leaf folding skills, claw the kernels and tighten the strings.
stories.intro: Banh têt is a traditional dish that is present everywhere, but the honey cake of Phu Quoc has a proud appearance. The cake is not round but beveled into a fancy triangular prism, surrounded by many layers of neatly folded leaves. Chop a piece of cake, you will immediately be seduced by the green fragrant glutinous rice that fully embraces the fatty meat and fatty green bean filling. What makes that unique difference comes from the specific type of honeysuckle leaf used to wrap the cake.
stories.image_alt: Phu Quoc honey leaf tacos are neatly wrapped
stories.image_caption: Honeysuckle leaf tacos are introduced in Phu Quoc, documentary photo of local cakes.

sections.heading: The narrow-leaf ship makes the shape of the cake
sections.body: Unlike large banana leaves, honeysuckle leaves have the characteristics of a narrow horizontal leaf surface and a fairly sturdy leaf vein system. Before wrapping, the leaves must be poured in boiling water to soften, then washed and cleaned carefully. The baker must skillfully put many leaf vessels together to enclose the entire glutinous part and filling, then squeeze his hands tightly to shape the cake into veins with sharp edges. Just admiring a cake wrapped squarely and neatly, we can see how meticulous and skilled this stage requires the craftsmanship.

sections.heading: Tie it tightly to make a delicious cake
sections.body: Even the hard tendons of the honeysuckle leaves are stripped to make the cake tie. The technique of squeezing the lat is an art: tie the hands loosely, the cake broth will soak in to make the sticky rice; squeezing too tightly causes the glutinous rice seeds to swell, unable to swell and cook evenly. Folklore has many anecdotes explaining why Phu Quoc people choose honeysuckle leaves instead of banana leaves, but so far, there are not enough historical documents to confirm for sure which variant is the authentic origin of this specialty cake.

sections.heading: Eat a ring, clearly see the glutinous layer and filling
sections.body: The classic honey taco recipe usually uses delicious glutinous rice, beaten green beans, and creamy pork belly; the outer layer of the glutinous coat is usually dyed green with fragrant pandan or peony leaf juice. However, depending on the secret of each bakery, they can flexibly change the filling, cake size, and dosage of ingredients to adjust the fat. If you're buying honey cake as a gift or need to find a vegetarian filling, be sure to ask the seller carefully about the filling of the exact batch you're buying, as well as the time and storage method so that the cake doesn't spoil during travel.

stories.title: Phu Quoc cakes: look at the small cakes to see the ingenuity
stories.dek: From pinched flowers, delicate spirals to funny animals, every shape of the cake is molded by talented hands. Each cake oven hides its own filling recipe and secrets, creating a variety that does not follow any one stereotype.
stories.intro: Stopping in front of a skillful cake stall, what holds tourists' steps is sometimes not necessarily the smell of fragrant buttermilk, but their extremely eye-catching shape. The beautiful little cakes are arranged evenly, some are spreading their wings like flowers, some are spiraling, and some have the funny appearance of a tiny animal. The name "skillful cake" sounds very rustic and simple, but it most accurately reflects the heart and talent that the worker has put into each kneading.

sections.heading: Skillful from the moment of cake molding
sections.body: The baking process requires the worker to be meticulous from dividing the dough, placing the filling to shaping or pressing the mold to shape. The smaller the cake size, the more it takes a pair of skilled and accustomed hands to maintain the uniformity of the lines and keep the soft filling from spilling out of the thin crust. Not all bakery stalls sell identical designs; just by looking at a batch of cakes, you can identify some of the "signatures" and unique styles of each bakery.

sections.heading: Bean filling, coconut filling and many variations
sections.body: In addition to the three most popular traditional filling flavors, namely mung bean, coconut, and taro, many bakeries today also create countless other new fillings. Even the recipe for mixing the crust dough or the baking/steaming method of cooking the cake has distinct differences between production facilities. Therefore, never assume that the cake you are enjoying is stamped from a single recipe, even if they share the same name.

sections.heading: Choose the cake according to your favorite taste
sections.body: If you want to choose a skillful cake as a gift, ask the shop owner about the expiration date and best storage conditions. For those who are allergic to flour, milk, legumes or other ingredients, it is mandatory to ask the seller directly, because the pretty appearance of the cake cannot denounce all the hidden inside the filling. And if you are lucky enough to have the opportunity to watch the artisans do it, you will suddenly realize that the true beauty of this cake is the magical performance of the fingers that are quickly kneading the dough.

stories.title: Good fish salad in Hon Mot, a little-known roll
stories.dek: In 2022, an article revealed a unique good fish salad in Hon Mot area, enjoyed in the style of rice paper rolls, raw vegetables and dipped in mixed fish sauce. Since the main ingredient is raw fish, you need to ask the restaurant's menu in advance and consider carefully before tasting.
stories.intro: In addition to the herring salad that is too familiar to tourists, the area around Hon Mot also contains an esoteric delicacy with a rather strange name: good fish salad. Fresh fish fillets are mixed with thinly sliced onions, fatty grated coconut and crispy roasted peanuts, then rolled in a layer of rice paper with herbs and dipped in a cup of sweet and sour fish sauce. This dish is a real specialty in the Hon Mot area, but because the sea does not always bestow this fish, if you want to have the opportunity to enjoy it, you have to take the trouble to contact the restaurants in advance.
stories.image_alt: A good plate of fish salad in the article noting the food around Hon Mot, Phu Quoc
stories.image_caption: Good fish salad in Hon Mot culinary report in 2022. Dishes using raw fish.

sections.heading: A salad with all kinds of flavors
sections.body: According to the article recorded in 2022, the fibers of fresh fish meat are thinly sliced and mixed well with onions, grated coconut and sprinkled with roasted peanuts. Diners will use rice paper to roll the fish salad with herbs and dip it into a cup of fish sauce mixed according to their own recipe. The sweet and fresh fish flavor is tightly intertwined with the greasy taste of grated coconut, the fleshy taste of peanuts and the strong aroma of raw vegetables, awakening all senses. Of course, the art of making dipping sauces or the choice of accompanying vegetables may vary depending on the culinary taste of each chef.

sections.heading: Good fish is the local name
sections.body: When you go to the restaurant to enjoy, talk to the seller about what kind of fish they are using to make the salad and whether they caught any good fish today; because the restaurant's menu depends entirely on the harvest of each sea trip.

sections.heading: Lemon recurring fish is still uncooked fish
sections.body: Lemon juice or sour vinegar has the effect of changing the color of fish meat and firming the surface, but it is absolutely impossible to turn raw seafood into safely pasteurized cooked dishes. Guests with sensitive digestive systems or are afraid of the risks of eating raw food are best advised to choose fish dishes that have been thoroughly cooked at temperature. For those who are allergic to fish or peanuts, it is important to ask carefully about the ingredients of the dipping sauce as well as ask if the restaurant uses the same food preparation utensils. A good fish salad has a fascinating culinary culture story, but health and safety criteria must always be a top priority in the face of the temptation to experiment with unfamiliar dishes.

stories.title: Barracuda cakes, from a batch of cinnamon fish to a bowl of hot soup cakes
stories.dek: Barracuda meat is finely chopped with spices, transforming into ethereal steamed patties or fragrant crispy fried patties. Although each kitchen owns its own seasoning recipe, the characteristic chewiness of barracuda cakes is always the perfect highlight for a bowl of hot soup.
stories.intro: The soul of a bowl of hot and smoky Phu Quoc soup is sometimes decided by the crispy chewy fish cakes lying on top. According to local culinary records, fresh barracuda after being pureed will be marinated with shallots, skull pepper and then stirred continuously until it reaches the ideal toughness. The finished fish cake can be steamed in a water bath or fried golden, served with white rice or dropped into water dishes.
